name: Consistencia del Mapa de Atención
description: Analiza spatial attention patrones para detectar inconsistencias typical of generado por IA images.
algorithm: Self-Attention Consistency Analysis for Synthetic Image Detection
mechanism: generado por IA images often exhibit unnatural attention patrones where different regions show inconsistent levels of detail. This method analiza local contraste, detail density, and sharpness distribución maps.
parameters: Attention map: gradiente-weighted, Scales: 3 (fine/medium/coarse), Consistency: cross-scale correlación
source: Zhao, T. et al. (2023) — Multi-Attentional Deepfake Detection, CVPR
useCase: Detecting generado por IA images by identifying unnatural spatial attention distribucións

references.title: Zhao, T. et al. (2023) — Multi-Attentional Deepfake Detection, CVPR

strengths:
• Captures high-level semantic artefactos
• Works a través de generation methods
• Multi-scale análisis
• Interpretable attention maps
limitations:
• Requires sufficient image complexity
• May struggle with simple scenes
• Attention patrones vary by content
• Training-dependent performance
